title: Ginger Helps Everyone
moral: Helping others and working together can solve big problems.

scenes.summary: Ginger the giraffe lives in Africa and can reach tall trees.
scenes.text: Once upon a time, there was a giraffe named Ginger. Ginger lived in Africa. She had a long neck and long legs. She could eat leaves from the tops of tall trees. Other animals could not reach as high as Ginger.
scenes.image_prompt: tall giraffe eating leaves from a tree in African savannah with small animals watching, colorful cartoon style

scenes.summary: A drought makes the land dry and Mickey becomes weak and hungry.
scenes.text: One day, the land was very dry because it had not rained. Ginger met her friend Mickey the monkey. Mickey was very tired and hungry. He fell down because he had no food to eat.
scenes.image_prompt: dry savannah with tired monkey collapsing near giraffe under hot sun, bright cartoon illustration

scenes.summary: Ginger helps Mickey and they go to ask Leo the lion for help.
scenes.text: Ginger gave Mickey some leaves to eat. Mickey felt better. They decided to ask Leo the lion for help. Mickey rode on Ginger’s back and they walked across the savannah to find Leo.
scenes.image_prompt: giraffe carrying monkey across savannah toward lion sitting on rock, colorful children's cartoon

scenes.summary: Animals move together but a fire suddenly spreads across the dry land.
scenes.text: Leo told them to move closer to the forest for food. All the animals began to travel together. Suddenly, lightning started a fire in the dry grass. The fire spread quickly and the animals were scared.
scenes.image_prompt: animals running away from grass fire with lightning in sky, dramatic colorful cartoon style

scenes.summary: Ginger leads the animals to safety and rain brings food back.
scenes.text: Ginger used her height to find a safe path. She led all the animals away from the fire. Soon, rain began to fall and put out the fire. The plants grew again and there was food for everyone. All the animals were happy.
scenes.image_prompt: rain falling on happy animals in savannah with giraffe leading them safely, bright cheerful cartoon style

story: Once upon a time, there was a giraffe named Ginger. Ginger lived in Africa. She had a long neck and long legs. She could eat leaves from the tops of tall trees. Other animals could not reach as high as Ginger. One day, the land was very dry because it had not rained. Ginger met her friend Mickey the monkey. Mickey was very tired and hungry. He fell down because he had no food to eat. Ginger gave Mickey some leaves to eat. Mickey felt better. They decided to ask Leo the lion for help. Mickey rode on Ginger’s back and they walked across the savannah to find Leo. Leo told them to move closer to the forest for food. All the animals began to travel together. Suddenly, lightning started a fire in the dry grass. The fire spread quickly and the animals were scared. Ginger used her height to find a safe path. She led all the animals away from the fire. Soon, rain began to fall and put out the fire. The plants grew again and there was food for everyone. All the animals were happy.
